note: Every Docker image the kit runs, pinned by digest. Code names images by tag; security/images.py pull fetches each image by the digest below and tags it locally, so a run uses exactly this content even if the tag moves upstream. security/check.py fails if the code names an image tag that is not listed here. A digest is the registry's: a multi-platform index where the image has one, otherwise the single manifest. Resolved from Docker Hub on 16 November 2026.
